GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2022-06-19T19:27:41Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Clone not supported for this type of IndexIVF
Description: # Summary

I'm trying to move a trained composite index to a GPU, so that adding embeddings (~5.8B) to the index is faster. However, my IndexIVF cannot be cloned onto the GPU. Here's a minimal reproducing snippet:

```
import faiss

index = faiss.index_factory(128, "OPQ4_64,IVF16384_HNSW32,PQ16x4fs")
xt = faiss.rand((20000, 128))
index.train(xt)

faiss.index_cpu_to_all_gpus(index)
```

which yields:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "tmp.py", line 7, in <module>
    faiss.index_cpu_to_all_gpus(index)
  File "/opt/conda/lib/python3.8/site-packages/faiss/__init__.py", line 887, in index_cpu_to_all_gpus
    index_gpu = index_cpu_to_gpus_list(index, co=co, gpus=None, ngpu=ngpu)
  File "/opt/conda/lib/python3.8/site-packages/faiss/__init__.py", line 899, in index_cpu_to_gpus_list
    index_gpu = index_cpu_to_gpu_multiple_py(res, index, co, gpus)
  File "/opt/conda/lib/python3.8/site-packages/faiss/__init__.py", line 882, in index_cpu_to_gpu_multiple_py
    index = index_cpu_to_gpu_multiple(vres, vdev, index, co)
  File "/opt/conda/lib/python3.8/site-packages/faiss/swigfaiss_avx2.py", line 10278, in index_cpu_to_gpu_multiple
    return _swigfaiss_avx2.index_cpu_to_gpu_multiple(provider, devices, index, options)
RuntimeError: Error in virtual faiss::IndexIVF* faiss::Cloner::clone_IndexIVF(const faiss::IndexIVF*) at /root/miniconda3/conda-bld/faiss-pkg_1641228905850/work/faiss/clone_index.cpp:71: clone not supported for this type of IndexIVF
```

Is this expected behavior? The IndexIVF I'm using doesn't seem to be special. I've also tried:

```
index_ivf = faiss.extract_index_ivf(index)
index_ivf = faiss.index_cpu_to_all_gpus(index_ivf)
```

with similar results.
